questions.stemHtml: A 23-year-old came to the surgery OPD with the complaint of a Lumpy Breast. On examination firm, easily movable mass is noted on the breast. History of waxing and waning with the menstrual cycle is present. No other significant history is given by the patient. An Ultrasound breast was done. The most appropriate management of the lesion measuring ~2*2cm is:

options.label: D
options.text: Tru-cut Biopsy to rule out cancer
